coordinate_system: local ENU metres, same AEQD origin as Gazebo
method: Manual ground-level tracing of the recorded official winter orthophoto. Central paths and gardens retraced 2026-10-26 to exclude green roofs/parapets; QGroundControl screenshot supplied by user confirms the older central layout but predates the Arena. Arena location and completed hall are retained. Routes/widths are approximations; mixed-date scene, not survey or access guidance. Pixel positions transformed EPSG:3857 to world AEQD. Remaining frontage, office and courtyard crossings corrected against native footprints; full-width walking routes validated before clipping. Roof displacement in aerial imagery is not treated as a ground-wall position.
